Equipped with up to 13th Gen Intel processors, it delivers the speed and efficiency you need to tackle your tasks with ease.Processor: Intel Core i5-1334U (Up to 4.6 GHz Max Boost Clock, 12 MB L3 Cache, 10 cores, 12 threads) Graphics: Intel Iris Xe GraphicsDisplay: 15.6-inch FHD (1920 x 1080) Anti-Glare IPS Touch DisplayOperating system: Windows 11 ProSoftware: Free Lifetime Microsoft OfficeMemory: 32 GB DDR4 RAMStorage: 1 TB (512 GB SSD + 500 GB External Drive)Optical Drive: NoWireless Connectivity: Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.3 comboAudio: MaxxAudio Pro with stereo speakersKeyboard: Full-size keyboard with numeric keypadWebcam: HD cameraPorts:1x USB Type-C 5Gbps signaling rate (supports data transfer only)1x USB Type-A 5Gbps signaling rate1x USB Type-A 2.01x HDMI 1.41x Multimedia SD Card Reader1x Headphone/microphone combo1x AC smart pinBattery: 3-cell, 65 Wh Li-ion battery, Up to 9 hoursColor: Carbon BlackDimensions (W x D x H): 14.11 x 9.27 x 0.75 inchesWeight: 3.66 lbsAccessory: MarxsolAccessory (6-in-1 USB-C docking station hub, USB extension cord, HDMI cable, mouse pad, wireless mouse, and 500GB external drive)

items: 【10-Core 13th Gen Intel i5-1334U Processor】Featuring up to 4.6GHz Max Boost Clock, 12MB Intel Smart Cache, 10 cores, and 12 threads, the Intel Core i5-1334U delivers efficient power for everyday tasks. Built with the latest platform technologies, it ensures fast connectivity, optimized performance, and smooth productivity—perfect for light gaming, work, and entertainment.

【32GB RAM + 1TB Storage (512GB SSD + 500GB Ext)】Equipped with 32GB of high-bandwidth DDR4 RAM, this system delivers smooth performance for gaming, video editing, and multitasking across multiple apps and browser tabs. The 512GB PCIe NVMe SSD offers up to 15x faster speed than a traditional hard drive, while the included 500GB external drive provides convenient portable storage.

【15.6" FHD IPS Touchscreen Display】Enjoy your content in vivid detail with a 15.6-inch Full HD display featuring 178-degree wide-viewing angles for consistent clarity. Navigate effortlessly using the responsive touchscreen—pinch, zoom, tap, and swipe for an intuitive, hands-on experience. The built-in HD camera and dual-array digital microphones ensure clear video and audio for calls and recordings.

【Windows 11 Pro Operating System】Windows 11 Pro offers a powerful, streamlined experience designed to help you stay focused and productive wherever you work. With built-in hardware-based isolation, encryption, and advanced malware protection, your data stays secure and accessible from anywhere. Ideal for home users, students, professionals, small businesses, and enterprises.

【Specifics with Addon Plus Lifetime MS Office】Bonus add-ons includes 6-in-1 USB-C Docking Station Hub (with USB 3.0, 4K-HDMI, USB C Connection, SD/TF Card Reader), HDMI cable, USB cable, mouse pad, wireless mouse, and 500GB portable external drive for your daily work and life. Free lifetime Microsoft Office included. Online Class, Google Classroom, Remote Learning, Zoom Ready.
